items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: Harold Dajon is mentioned only in the interviewer's closing remarks ('Harold Dajon and Ralph Collins and this is Bill Russell') as part of the recording credits or attendees, with no interaction or personal relationship described by the interviewee.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, my father was speaking. He was speaking Creole French.

In fact, he couldn't speak English too good because when I talked to him or something, he'd say some words but he had to say something. You remember him, Harold. Sure, I remember. You remember him then well, huh?
I never did 20 some odd years ago. I remember. I'm 52.
